name: Stari Grad (Old Town)
tagline: Walled medieval heart on the peninsula
description: Budva's walled old town is a compact maze of narrow stone lanes, churches, squares and a citadel on a small peninsula. Atmospheric and beautiful, it is the town's romantic core, ringed by cafes and restaurants, though summer crowds and higher prices come with the postcard setting.
vibe: Historic, romantic, atmospheric and lively in season
bestFor: Culture lovers who want to live inside the old town charm
pros: Stunning medieval setting and stone streets
Walkable to beaches, cafes and the marina
cons: Crowded and noisy in peak summer

name: Slovenska Plaza / Main Strip
description: The long Slovenska Plaza beach and its strip are the busy modern face of Budva, lined with hotels, bars, restaurants and shops just steps from the old town. Central and convenient, it is the liveliest, most touristy part of town, at its best in the shoulder season.
bestFor: Beach-first visitors who want everything on the doorstep
pros: Plenty of dining, shops and nightlife
Easy transport connections along the coast
cons: Very crowded and loud in peak summer

name: Becici
description: Just south of Budva, Becici is a calmer resort with one of the coast's longest sandy beaches and a more relaxed, family-friendly feel. It offers space and sea views while staying a short hop from Budva's old town and nightlife, making it a mellower base.
bestFor: Nomads wanting beach living with a quieter pace
pros: Long sandy beach and open space
Close to town yet more peaceful

name: Sveti Stefan / Petrovac
description: South along the Budva Riviera lie the famous islet-resort of Sveti Stefan and the laid-back town of Petrovac. This stretch trades party energy for scenery and calm, with beautiful coves and pink-sand beaches, offering a slower, more upscale or authentic base a short drive from Budva.
vibe: Scenic, calmer, upscale near Sveti Stefan and easygoing in Petrovac
bestFor: Those prioritizing scenery and quiet over nightlife
cons: Sveti Stefan area can be pricey
